name: How do I choose between traditional stucco and synthetic stucco for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between traditional stucco and synthetic stucco for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between traditional (cement-based) and synthetic (EIFS) stucco depends on your priorities. Traditional stucco is a time-tested, rigid material known for its hardness, fire resistance, and durability. It breathes well, making it less prone to moisture issues if properly installed. Synthetic stucco offers greater insulation properties, flexibility, and a smoother, more uniform finish. It's lighter and can be applied faster. Consider traditional for a classic, robust option, or synthetic for enhanced energy efficiency and modern aesthetics. Consult with a professional to evaluate your home's specific needs and climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose traditional stucco for durability and breathability, or synthetic stucco (EIFS) for better insulation and a smoother finish; your choice depends on your priorities and home's needs.
